user.title: Add an alarm clock
user.description: Link a Kiosk Satellite to the voice satellite it belongs to. The admin password is only used once to obtain a long-lived token; only the token is stored.

data_description.satellite_entity_id: The Assist satellite entity on the same device as the kiosk. Voice commands from this satellite set alarms on this kiosk.
data_description.verify_ssl: Turn this off for the kiosk's self-signed certificate.

reauth_confirm.title: Log in again
reauth_confirm.description: The kiosk {name} no longer accepts the stored token. Enter the kiosk admin password to get a new one.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the kiosk. Check the address, the port and that remote administration is on.
error.unknown: Unexpected response from the kiosk. See the Home Assistant log.

abort.already_configured: This voice satellite already has an alarm clock.

init.title: Speech-to-Phrase
init.description: Options are shared by all alarm clocks; the first one added decides. Changing them reloads the integration.

data.manage_speech_to_phrase: Manage the Speech-to-Phrase sentence file and restart the add-on when it changes
